title: Anthropic opens a new public study of what people want from AI
friendlyTitle: Anthropic asks people what they want from AI
summary: Anthropic launched a new interview study asking Claude users about meaningful experiences with AI, changes they want in work and society, and what they expect from AI companies. Participants may choose to publish their complete interview and country, but Anthropic warns that details in the text could still identify them.
friendlySummary: A new study asks Claude users about their good and bad experiences with AI and what they want AI companies to do. People can choose whether their full interview is made public.
whyItMatters: The study creates a channel for users to describe practical benefits and harms in their own words, and optional public transcripts could support outside research. Participants should treat publication as effectively permanent and avoid sharing details that could identify themselves or others.
friendlyWhyItMatters: The answers may help researchers understand how AI affects daily life. If you join, do not share personal details because a public interview could be linked back to you.
